relations.name: Vegetable and Beef Skillet
relations.rationale: The robust flavors of Berbere complement the savory and hearty ingredients in the Vegetable and Beef Skillet.

relations.name: Ras el Hanout
relations.rationale: Both Berbere and Ras el Hanout are complex spice blends that can be swapped in similar savory dishes or used to enhance marinades.

relations.name: Harissa
relations.rationale: Both Berbere and Harissa are spicy blends; they can be used together to elevate the heat and flavor in various dishes.

relations.name: Miso Butter Ramen
relations.rationale: Using Berbere as a spice can add an interesting twist to the umami-rich broth of the Miso Butter Ramen, enhancing its complexity.
